description: NT Infrastructure Plan and Pipeline 2022 is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Logistics and Infrastructure. The NT Infrastructure Plan and Pipeline 2022 provides a detailed roadmap to the investments that will enact Government’s vision of a sustainable and diverse $40 billion economy by 2030. The focus is on a place-based approach, which was strongly supported through the consultation feedback. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Logistics and Infrastructure. Its tags are Infrastructure, Plan. It offers 2 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
